Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has side lengths 6 cm, 9 cm, and 11 cm. What type of triangle is it based on its sides? : Scalene-triangle Isosceles-triangle Equilateral-triangle
Hints: Check if any sides are the same length.
Solution: Scalene-triangle. A triangle with no equal sides is called a scalene triangle.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has angle measures 35°, 55°, and 90°. What type of triangle is this based on its angles? : Acute-triangle Right-triangle Obtuse-triangle
Solution: Right-triangle. One angle is 90°, so the triangle is a right triangle.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has angles 110°, 40°, and 30°. What type of triangle is it based on angles? : Acute-triangle Right-triangle Obtuse-triangle
Solution: Obtuse-triangle. One angle is greater than 90°, so the triangle is obtuse.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A triangle has angles 45°, 45°, and 90°. What type of triangle is it based on its sides? : Scalene-triangle Isosceles-triangle Equilateral-triangle
Hints: Different angles mean different side lengths
Solution: Isosceles-triangle. Two angles are equal (45° and 45°), so two opposite sides must be equal length.

Question Choices: A pyramid's side face is a triangle with side lengths of 8 meters, 8 meters, and 6 meters. What type of triangle is this face based on its sides? : Scalene-triangle Isosceles-triangle Equilateral-triangle
Hints: Think about a triangle with at least 2 equal sides
Solution: Isosceles-triangle. Two sides are 8 meters long, so at least two sides are equal.
